sections.heading: About this project
text_lines: Venkatesh Erandwane Central - BUILDING-B1 - Phase 2 (MahaRERA P52100032631) is a residential project by SHREE VENKATESH BUILDCON PVT LTD in
. It was launched in January 2022. It has 174 units in 1 building, with 2 & 3 BHK homes as registered with MahaRERA. Its MahaRERA status is Active.

Its registered possession date is September 2026, unchanged since launch. Construction: excavation complete, structure (RCC) 76% complete, final finishes 12% complete. MahaRERA records do not show it as ready to move in.

144 of 174 units are booked (83%). Since the December 2025 update, the reported concrete structure (RCC) has gone from 100% to 76%. 80% of the flats sold here in 2025 went for ₹22,700 per sq ft or less (down 2% on 2024), counting balconies and terrace in the size, based on 13 registered sales we found. Buyers here paid a rate about 25% higher than at other Erandwane projects in 2025.
Figures are as reported to MahaRERA, not verified by FlatNama.
Concrete structure (RCC) is the reinforced-concrete frame. Final finishes means lifts, services, common areas and other works needed before handover, not the finishes inside each flat.
On MahaRERA, Lapsed means the registered possession date has passed and the developer has not filed an extension or recorded the project as complete. It does not by itself mean work has stopped.
Total internal area = carpet + balcony + terrace, as Pune sales offices quote “carpet area”. Price per sq ft counts balconies and terrace in the size.
Prices are of the flat alone; stamp duty, registration and GST are extra, so the total is usually 10–15% more.
Prices in a project usually rise as construction progresses. Floor, view and flat size move the price up or down, so treat these figures as a guide.
Rates also vary with the exact project location.
Prices come from sale records obtained from IGR Maharashtra, which may not include every sale.
Complaints are the count MahaRERA shows for the project; they include complaints filed by the builder against buyers.
Please do your own checks before you buy.
